liveModuleComparisons.decision: bounded at 61.1 seconds; trailed the SRB ascent to comparable apoapsis, with no complete Heavy orbit attempt verified

learnedGuards: Prefer high-contrast HUD Ap, Pe, altitude, speed, and vertical speed over unvalidated F3 values.
Accept F3 position and velocity only when derived altitude and speed agree with the HUD.
Reject impossible single-frame attitude jumps before issuing a steering pulse.
Never deploy the recovery parachute during ascent.
Revert immediately on stale telemetry, heading divergence, noncompetitive coast, suborbital descent, or best-time expiry.
